s.note: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water and a pinch of sugar. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Roll in 80g sugar mixed with cinnamon while hot.

s.note: the stampede through the living room
s.how: Toss 150g roasted peanuts, 100g cashews, 80g banana chips, 80g chopped dried mango and 100g dark chocolate chunks with a pinch of sea salt. Tip into a big wooden bowl.

m.note: the hunter who comes out of the game
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, pepper and thyme. Sear to rare and rest. Add 150ml red wine and 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g parsnips and 400g potatoes with butter.

w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 3 eggs, 200ml maple syrup, 80g brown sugar and 60g melted butter. Stir in 200g toasted pecans, pour in and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and 3 strips orange peel over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and serve hot.
